annotations.title: CVE lookup: severity, known exploitation, EPSS and fixes for a vulnerability

description: Look up a CVE by its ID: what the vulnerability is, its CVSS score and severity, whether CISA lists it as exploited in the wild (KEV) and since when, the EPSS probability of exploitation in the next 30 days, CISA's SSVC points, the weakness (CWE), affected products with fixed versions, and patch and advisory links. Use to triage a security alert, rank what to patch first, or check an advisory before upgrading a dependency. Example: cve=CVE-2021-44228. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
